summary: Lake County, MT lookout site listed under Montana DNRC: 1923 platform at Goat Creek G.S., 1930s tree platform; both sources say abandoned, not gone; no current state found.

facts.design: 30-foot platform in a yard (1923); 100-foot tree platform (1930s)
facts.status_note: Both sources say abandoned. Firelookout.com says the 100-foot tree platform was still there in the 1980s. No source says whether any of it stands now.

access.note: No source we read says whether the site is open to the public.

events.note: 30-foot platform in the yard at Goat Creek G.S.

evidence.supports: built 1923 as a 30-foot platform in the yard at Goat Creek G.S.
evidence.quote: 1923: 30' platform in yard at Goat Creek G.S.

evidence.supports: 1930s 100-foot tree platform, still there in the 1980s
location 12 miles south of Swan Lake, Lake County
Lake County list pairs the site with Montana DNRC and survey code 23N-17W-18

notes_for_editor: The 1930s tree platform has no exact year, so it is not an event; it appears in the story as 'the 1930s'. Firelookout.com's Goat Creek G.S. is kept as written; the abbreviation is not expanded. A 1923 photo caption in the 2023 Seeley Swan Pathfinder article ('Jim Cr. Lookout') is for Jim Creek, a different lookout; do not merge. Status should be reviewed in the record.
